title: 第12章 这破天的机缘要怎么守
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
“醒了？”

    顾念念刚睁开眼，一道熟悉且柔和的声音就从她耳边传来。

    她微微侧头，嘴角泛起一丝甜笑。

    “师兄！”

    明明是欢快欣喜的语调，只是声音略显虚弱低哑。

    洛靳将她半抱起来，一盏灵露喂到了她的唇边。

    顾念念低头喝了一口，是甜的，她眼底冒出点点星光，自己端了杯子喝了个干净。

    末了还意犹未尽地舔了舔嘴唇。

    洛靳失笑。

    “灵露是好东西，但也不可多饮。”

    顾念念一开始还不理解洛靳说的不可多饮是什么意思，但是很快就明白了。

    一股暖流从自己的喉咙间一路下滑，直至蔓延到四肢百骨。

    就像是小溪流水，她能清楚地感受到暖流在身体里的每一个流向。

    她惊奇地看向陆靳。

    “师兄，我的身体里好像有暖流在流动。”

    洛靳笑着点头。

    “看来比我想象的效果还要好。”

    洗筋伐髓，不是只有功法和灵宝，还有这世间罕有的灵露。

    不过，这东西对现在顾念念来说不过是锦上添花。

    洛靳不准备多说，只是伸手去给她把脉。

    手指搭上脉门的那一刻，他眼底划过一抹惊奇。

    这丫头竟是无声无息的到了练气四层。

    两天时间！

    从毫无修为的废灵根凡人，到炼气四层。

    这种速度堪称恐怖。

    洛靳松开手，面色平静。

    顾念念歪着头看他，面上带着淡淡的疑惑，藏在被子下的手却悄然握紧。

    “师兄，我怎么了吗？”

    洛靳轻轻摇头。

    “没什么，饿不饿？”

    顾念念摸了摸肚子，露出一个不好意思的笑。

    “好像有点。”

    洛靳从储物戒指里取出一碟糕点，放在她面前。

    “先垫一垫，胡三一会儿送饭来。”

    顾念念抓起一块糕点就往嘴里塞，腮帮子鼓鼓的，像只小仓鼠。

    洛靳看着她，眼底的冷意不知不觉化开了几分。

    “慢点吃，没人跟你抢。”

    顾念念含糊不清地应了一声，手却没停。

    洛靳看着她吃，轻声问：“什么都不问吗？”

    顾念念鼓着腮帮子，含糊不清地反问：“我要问什么？”

    “不奇怪那些人为什么找你麻烦？”

    顾念念咽下一口，又去咬下一口。

    “因为我有肉吃，他们没有！”

    洛靳一愣。
content_en:
"Are you awake?"

    As soon as Gu Niannian opened her eyes, a familiar and soft voice came from her ears.

    She tilted her head slightly, a sweet smile appearing at the corner of her mouth.

    "Brother!"

    It was obviously a cheerful tone, but the voice was slightly weak and hoarse.

    Luo Jin half-hugged her and fed a cup of spiritual dew to her lips.

    Gu Niannian lowered her head and took a sip. It was sweet. Starlight appeared in her eyes. She took the cup and drank it all.

    At the end, he licked his lips without saying anything.

    Luo Jin laughed.

    "Spiritual dew is a good thing, but don't drink too much."

    Gu Niannian didn't understand what Luo Jin meant by not drinking too much at first, but she soon understood.

    A warm current slid down from his throat until it spread to his limbs and bones.

    Like water in a small stream, she could clearly feel the warmth flowing in every direction in her body.

    She looked at Lu Jin in surprise.

    "Senior brother, there seems to be warmth flowing in my body."

    Luo Jin smiled and nodded.

    "It seems to be more effective than I imagined."

    Cleansing the tendons and cutting the marrow not only involves exercises and spiritual treasures, but also spiritual dew that is rare in this world.

    However, this thing is just the icing on the cake for Gu Niannian now.

    Luo Jin wasn't going to say anything more, he just stretched out his hand to feel her pulse.

    The moment his fingers touched his pulse gate, a flash of surprise flashed in his eyes.

    This girl reached the fourth level of Qi training silently.

    Two days!

    From a mortal with useless spiritual roots without any cultivation, to the fourth level of Qi refining.

    This speed is terrifying.

    Luo Jin let go of his hand and looked calm.

    Gu Niannian tilted her head and looked at him, with a hint of doubt on her face, but her hand hidden under the quilt was quietly clenched.

    "Brother, what's wrong with me?"

    Luo Jin shook his head gently.

    "Nothing, are you hungry?"

    Gu Niannian touched her belly and smiled sheepishly.

    "It seems a bit."

    Luo Jin took out a plate of pastries from the storage ring and placed it in front of her.

    "Put a cushion first, Hu San will bring the food later."

    Gu Niannian grabbed a piece of pastry and stuffed it into her mouth, her cheeks bulging like a little hamster.

    Luo Jin looked at her, and the coldness in his eyes melted away a little unconsciously.

    "Eat slowly, no one will compete with you."

    Gu Niannian responded vaguely, but her hands did not stop.

    Luo Jin watched her eating and asked softly, "Don't you want to ask anything?"

    Gu Niannian puffed up her cheeks and asked vaguely, "What do I want to ask?"

    "Aren't you surprised why those people are causing trouble for you?"

    Gu Niannian swallowed a mouthful and took another bite.

    "Because I have meat to eat and they don't!"

    Luo Jin was stunned.
title_en: Chapter 12 How to keep this incredible opportunity?
